title: feat(search): add whole-word matching and unify search panel in demo
body:
## Summary / 摘要

Add whole-word search matching to `@floatboat/nexus-plugin-search`, unify electron-demo on the CM6 search panel, and polish demo UX (save, vault, toolbar, dark chrome).

为 `@floatboat/nexus-plugin-search` 增加全词匹配，electron-demo 统一使用 CM6 搜索面板，并改进 demo 体验（保存、vault、工具栏、深色 chrome）。

## Changes / 变更内容

- `packages/plugin-search`: `wholeWord` option, `buildSearchPattern()`, reworked search panel, `openSearchPanelIn()`
- `apps/electron-demo`: remove `search-bar.ts`, Ctrl+S fix, vault close/external file, dark toolbar + tooltip clamping

## Testing / 测试

- [x] `pnpm test` — 326 passed
- [x] `pnpm build` — passed
- [x] Manual UI check in electron-demo
